name: heliograph
description: Debug and change a machine you cannot log into, through an operator who cannot debug it - for air-gapped, client-owned and change-controlled estates where nobody will be giving you SSH. Git is the transport in both directions: you push a step, they run one command that never changes, and the whole run comes back as a log with a UTC timestamp on every line, ANSI stripped and obvious secrets masked. Ships a bash toolkit (step runner, unattended git-polling agent, ad-hoc capture wrapper, SSH/Windows/Terraform/Ansible probes) plus the method for debugging across a gap. No packages, no credentials, no tunnel.
